data.heading: Two left feet welcome
data.subheading: Friendly dance classes for complete beginners

data.content:
A studio for people who think they can't dance

Quickstep Dance Studio is a small, made-up studio. Every class starts from the very first step, and nobody is watching your feet except you.

data.heading: Our classes
data.intro: Pick a style and come as you are.

data.alt: A stick figure with a red bow, dancing
data.content:
Hello, I'm Luna Quickstep

Luna Quickstep is a fictional person, invented for this demo. She tripped over her own feet at a school dance, decided to learn properly, and has been teaching beginners ever since.

items.question: Do I need a partner?
items.answer: No. We rotate partners in every class.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: Anything you can move in, and shoes you can turn in.

items.question: I have never danced. Is that all right?
items.answer: That is exactly who these classes are for.
